policy: Use reviewed official base face-value contracts for raw-point ranking. Exchange-route fees, destination-specific ratios, temporary bonuses and campaigns must not redefine a source point's base face value. Unknown/ambiguous base rates fail closed.

moppy.note: Official Moppy page states 1 point = 1 yen.

warau.note: Nightly ranking already requires the current first-party rate page to confirm 1 point = 1 yen.

chobirich.note: Rate changed in 2026. Official help now states 1 Chobirich point = 1 yen. Never use the historical 2pt=1JPY rate.

coincome.note: Official site exposes yen-equivalent values. Ranking must use parser-verified displayedRewardYen, not infer a CIM conversion.

mikoshi.note: BHI's official MIKOSHI release states 1 MIKOSHI point = 1 yen. Destination-specific exchange ratios (for example DotMoney routes) are not used to redefine the base MIKOSHI point value for cross-site ranking.

gendama.note: Current parser requires an adjacent first-party '(円相当)' value and uses displayedRewardYen. Raw pt is never converted heuristically.

kurashiru_reward.note: Official site states 100 coins = 1 yen equivalent. Exchange fees are not part of base face-value ranking.

trima.note: Official Trip-Mile page states 100 miles = 1 yen conversion and notes exchange fees. Use only as face-value comparison when a reviewed offer parser exists.

point_income.note: Do not infer a conversion until a current first-party rate page and reviewed parser contract are added.

point_town.note: Official FAQ states 1 point = 1 yen. Coins are separate: 100 coins = 1 point.

ec_navi.note: Official help states 1 point = 0.1 yen equivalent.

nifty_point.note: Official FAQ states 1 point = 1 yen equivalent.

gmo_point.note: Do not infer a conversion until a current first-party rate page and reviewed parser contract are added.

powl.note: Current first-party Powl offer terms explicitly describe 1 yen equivalent as 10pt. Ranking uses the reviewed reward-parent total only; publication remains disabled.
